tool: census on the groups origin/main ships with this branch's detectors (curate.Curation._round8_pre, build_window, undated_siblings, plus_dependent, _hybrid_unread); lot rows = car x group rows of the vehicle-year in the main replay (audit11_4/lot_replay.mjs)

classes.no_own_page: no list row of its own for the number in the raw; the claim rests on product records or other pages (missing_pages: the list page the record was captured from)
classes.window_other_page: a built gate whose window is not printed on the vehicle-year's own row
classes.undated_siblings: same-option numbers (one configuration's words inside the other's) on the page, none dated, predecessors / successors aside

live_files: the 8 shipped groups files are byte-identical to origin/main (cmp) after re-curation with this branch's code; round-8 rules apply to curate.ROUND8_NS = {nissan} only
